title: Miami Travel Poster
coreRelationships: The woman's figure is central and dominant, occupying the lower-middle section of the poster.
The 'Miami' text and sunburst are positioned above the woman, acting as a bold header and focal point.
The airplane is a secondary element, placed in the upper left, suggesting travel and arrival.
The starfish in the lower right provides a whimsical beach-related detail.
The Braniff International Airways logo anchors the bottom of the composition.
reuseFormula: Create a stylized illustration with bold outlines and flat, saturated colors. Feature a central, relaxed figure in a vacation setting (e.g., beach, poolside). Place a large, energetic text graphic for the destination above the figure. Include a small, iconic travel element (e.g., plane, ship) and a company logo at the bottom. Use a warm, light background with contrasting, vibrant accent colors.
